migration_flags.description: New trigger value 'on_webhook' enabling HTTP webhook-based automation execution with configurable record getter and optional audit logging
Formal mail message event triggers: on_message_received fires when author is portal/external partner, on_message_sent fires for internal users
Dedicated archive/unarchive triggers replacing generic write detection on the active field
Two new time-based triggers: on_time_created uses create_date, on_time_updated uses write_date as the reference date field
New server action type allowing duplication of a specified record with optional field linking
New server action type that POSTs a JSON payload to an external URL after commit; uses postcommit hook with 1-second timeout
New mail action type for removing specific or dynamically-resolved followers from a record
The actions One2many field is now named action_server_ids; keyed via base_automation_id FK on ir.actions.server; replaces legacy action_ids pattern
on_write trigger is deprecated; comment in source says 'use on_create_or_write instead'; still functional but should be migrated
Time-based automation cron now calls _commit_progress() after each automation, enabling partial progress commits on long-running cron jobs

key_findings.filter_semantics: filter_pre_domain evaluated before write; filter_domain evaluated after write; both use safe_eval with domain-only eval context
key_findings.cron_mechanism: Single shared ir.cron record; auto-activated when TIME_TRIGGERS rules exist; frequency = min(max(1, min_delay//10), 240) minutes
key_findings.action_server_ids: One2many to ir.actions.server via base_automation_id FK; all actions must share the rule model; executed sequentially in _process()
key_findings.hook_registration: ORM methods create/write/_compute_field_value/unlink/message_post patched at registry load via _register_hook()
